chapter.verse: Topa in Malakhi tung tawnin Israelte tungah thu gen hi.
Topa in, “Note kong it hi,” ci hi. Ahi zongin note in, “Kote hong bangci it na hi hiam?” na ci uh hi. Topa in hong dawng a, “Esau leh Jakob in unau hi a, ahi zongin Jakob leh a suan a khakte itin,
Esau leh a suan a khakte ka mudah hi. Esau’ neih mualtung gamte ka susia a, gamlak gamsate tungah ka pia hi,” ci hi.

Esau’ suan-le-khak Edom mite in, “I khuapite a kisiat khit hangin i lamkik ding hi,” ci le uh, Topa in, “A ut uh leh lam uh hen, ahi zongin ka susia kik veve ding hi. Midangte in, ‘Gam gilo, Topa ’ heh tawntungna minamte,’ ci-in ko ding uh hi,” ci-in dawng ding hi.
Note’ mit mahmah tawh hih thu piang na mu ding uh a, “Israel gam pualam nangawn ah, Topa in vangliatna nei hi,” na ci ding uh hi.

Vanglianpen Topa in siampite tungah hih bangin hong ci hi: “Tapa in a pa zahtak a, nasempa in a topa kihta hi. Keimah in na pa uh hi napi, bang hangin hong zahtak lo a, na Topa uh hi napi, bang hangin hong kihta lo na hi uh hiam? No siampte in kei hong simmawh napi-in, ‘Bang hong ci simmawh ka hi uh hiam?’ na ci lai uh hi.

Note in ka biakna tau tungah keimah biakna-in an ginalopite hong pia hi napi-in, ‘Kong zahtak bawl lohna uh bang om ahi hiam?’ na ci uh hi. Ka biakna tau simmawh bawl na hih manun hong zahtak bawl lo na hi uh hi.

Ganhing a mittawpite tawh kei nong biak uh ciangin, a hoih mahin kingaihsun na hi uh hiam? A khebai a, a cina ganhingte tawh nong biak uh ciangin, a hoih mah kisa na hi uh hiam? Tua bang ganhing khatpeuh peuh, note hong ukpa kiangah va puak dih un. Note tungah nuamin hong pakta ding ahi hiam?” ci hi.
Tua ciangin no siampite aw, Pasian in eite hong hehpih theih nadingin ama kiangah thuum un. Na hih ngeisa bangun na ngetnate uh hong pia lo ding a, tua in nomau’ khialhna ahi hi.

Vanglianpen Topa in, “Ka biakna tau tungah, bangmah-a a kimang lo mei na tawh mawkmawk theih loh nadingun, note khatpeuh in biakinn kongkhakte khak le uh cin ka ut hi. Note tungah ka lungkim kei a, nong puak uh biak piaknate kong sang kei ding hi.
Leitung khempeuh-a om minam khempeuh in kei hong zahtak uh a, kei’ adingin mun khempeuh ah paknamtui halin, a kisang thei ding biak piakna hong pia uh hi. Mi khempeuh in kei hong zahtak uh hi.
Ahi zongin note in keima biakna tau bangmah a man nei loin genin, tua biakna tau tunga na piak uh ante na thupi ngaihsut loh uh ciangin, keimah a hong simmawh na hi uh hi.

Note in, ‘Hihte cimtak khin hang,’ ci-in nap nong nitsan lel uh hi. Keimah biak nadingin a kigu ganhing khatpeuh ahi a, a liam a bai, ahih kei leh a cina peuh nong paipih uh hi. Tua bangte, a sang dingin hong ngaihsun na hi uh hiam?

A tuuhon lakah tuutal cidam nei napi-in, a kamciamsa bangin kei tungah hong piak ciangin, a sitbaang ganhing hong pia mi khempa in samsiatna thuak ta hen. Bang hang hiam cih leh keimah in a lian mahmah Kumpipa ka hi a, minam khempeuh in kei hong zahtak uh hi,” a ci hi.
